rubrics.justification: The model appropriately stated it could not see the image and based morphology on the provided Gardner 2BB grade. Its description of stage 2/full blastocyst, loosely grouped ICM, and loose TE is consistent with the supplied grading and does not fabricate image-specific details.

It integrates age, ovarian reserve, embryo stage, sperm parameters, endometrial thickness, BMI, lifestyle, and prior cycle history into prognosis, with appropriate emphasis on age-related aneuploidy as the dominant factor.

The reasoning is structured and largely consistent, linking morphology and patient factors to prognosis. Minor issues include overstatement that TE is the most critical predictor and some speculative comments about sperm DNA fragmentation/PCOS phenotype.

Recommendations are mostly evidence-based and aligned with common IVF practice: counseling, lifestyle optimization, consideration of PGT-A at age 42, and attention to endometrium/luteal support. Slight deviations include strong endorsement of PGT-A and freeze-all as broadly recommended rather than individualized.

Provides clear next steps for transfer counseling, lifestyle changes, luteal support, and future planning including PGT-A and sperm DNA fragmentation testing. Some recommendations are somewhat generic and not fully tailored to whether this is a fresh versus frozen transfer.
